240bb703a6 refactor: make translation-unit local functions static

These functions are only used within the file that defines them, and
have no declaration elsewhere, so -Wmissing-prototypes (clang) and
-Wmissing-declarations (GCC) warn about them. Give them internal
linkage.

fail_test_if_executed() is [[maybe_unused]], because TRACEPOINT discards
its arguments when tracing is disabled.

0019c33aac fuzz: declare libFuzzer entry points before defining them

LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and LLVMFuzzerInitialize are called by libFuzzer,
so they can't be static. Declare them first, to avoid
-Wmissing-prototypes / -Wmissing-declarations warnings.

010dd27003 rest: include httprpc.h for StartREST, InterruptREST and StopREST

b9cff75536 qt: declare ForceActivation in macdockiconhandler.h

It was declared locally in guiutil.cpp, so the definition was never
checked against the declaration.

0bc1d6c2e5 refactor: make functions only used in their own translation unit static

These functions are declared in a header, but only used in the file that
defines them. Remove the declarations and give them internal linkage.

51eac5e65a refactor: make overloads only used in their own translation unit static

These overloads (and the walletdb Load* helpers) are declared in a header,
but only used in the file that defines them. Remove the declarations and
give them internal linkage.

d7d613824b refactor: make forward-declared translation unit local functions static

Also drop the forward declarations, reordering definitions where needed.

a6bb744c57 refactor: declare functions used by tests in their module headers

71b510a640 rpc: declare getblockchaininfo and getdeploymentinfo in rpc/blockchain.h

0b9dee692c build: add -Wmissing-prototypes

7b8e76fe7e build: add -Wmissing-declarations

This is GCC's equivalent of clang's -Wmissing-prototypes for C++.
